newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Cleveland County, N.C..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Cleveland County, N.C..

text.p: Sealed bids will be received by the Local Government Commission of North Carolina at its office in the Albemarle Building, 4th Floor, Room 411, 325 North Salisbury Street, Raleigh, North Carolina 27603-1385, until 11 o'clock A.M., North Carolina Time, such bids to be opened in public at said time and place on said day, for the purchase of $6,055,000* General
Obligation Refunding Bonds, Series 1997, of the County of Cleveland, North Carolina, dated February 1, 1997, and maturing (subject to adjustment as described below)

Copies of the Official Statement and the Notice of Sale and Bid Form relating to the bonds may be obtained from the Local Government Commission (919-733-3064). Each bid must be submitted on a bid form in the Notice of Sale and Bid Form. The bonds will be delivered on or about February 11, 1997.
*Subject to adjustment as provided in the Official
Statement and the Notice of Sale and Bid Form
